extDescription.message: Automatically clears cookies and session data of chosen sites to limit the impact of cookie-stealing malware. Free, open-source, no telemetry.

optModeList.message: Clean only the sites in my list

optSitesHelp.message: Cookies, localStorage and IndexedDB of these domains (and their subdomains) will be wiped at each cleanup. You will be logged out of them.

optRevokeHelp.message: Deleting a cookie locally does not always kill the session on the server. For your monitored sites, use these official "connected devices" pages to revoke everything.

optRevokeNone.message: Add sites above to see their revocation pages.

optWhitelistHelp.message: These domains keep their cookies and sessions.

optStartup.message: Also clean when the browser starts

optStorage.message: Also purge localStorage / IndexedDB (recommended — this is where Discord-style tokens live)

optLeakEmailTitle.message: Has my email appeared in a breach?

optLeakEmailHelp.message: Without an API key this opens haveibeenpwned.com in a new tab. With a key (below), the check runs directly here.

optLeakPwdHelp.message: Anonymous check (k-anonymity): only the first 5 characters of the SHA-1 hash are sent. The password never leaves your device.

optApiHelp.message: Stored locally only. Enables direct email checks.

optLeakNone.message: No known breach for this address.

optApiRate.message: Rate limited — wait a few seconds.

optPwdFoundEnd.message: known breaches. Do not use it.

optDisclaimer.message: CookieCleaner reduces the time window during which a stolen cookie stays usable. It does not prevent theft itself: keep your system clean, use 2FA, and never run untrusted programs. Everything stays on your device — no telemetry, no server.
